source.section: Schedule M line 34 Social Security Benefits, 100% at or under the AGI limit and 65% above it for 2025 (PDF p.5; instructions PDF p.28; PDF p.17; Tax Division Social Security Modification page); IT-140 lines 1-8 (PDF p.3; instructions PDF p.26: exemptions 2,000 each, line 7 floored at zero); Rate Schedules I and II (PDF p.37); Tax Table (PDF p.38 on)

worked: Married filing jointly, 63 and 64, federal AGI over 100,000: line 34 takes 65% of the spouse's taxable benefits. You (Column A) born 1962-02-02, age 63 at December 31, 2025; Spouse (Column B) born 1961-11-11, age 64 at December 31, 2025. Federal taxable Social Security (IRS worksheet, given): other income 80,000.00 + half of benefits 20,000.00 = provisional income 100,000.00; 85% x (100,000.00 - 44,000.00) = 47,600.00 + lesser of 6,000.00 and half the benefits 20,000.00 = 53,600.00, limited to 85% of benefits 34,000.00: 34,000.00. Federal AGI (given) = wages 80,000.00 (you) + taxable Social Security 34,000.00 = 114,000.00. Federal taxable income (given, not tested) = 114,000.00 - standard deduction 31,500.00 = 82,500.00 (federal senior deduction ignored). IT-140 line 1 federal AGI 114,000.00. Schedule M additions lines 51-58 none; IT-140 line 2 0.00. Schedule M You (Column A): line 47: age 63, under 65 and not disabled, none; line 49 = 0.00. Schedule M Spouse (Column B): line 34(a) total benefits 40,000.00, (b) exempt for federal 6,000.00, (c) taxable 34,000.00; federal AGI 114,000.00 exceeds 100,000.00, so line 34 = 0.65 x 34,000.00 = 22,100.00; line 47: age 64, under 65 and not disabled, none; line 49 = 22,100.00. Line 50 total subtractions = 0.00 + 22,100.00 = 22,100.00. IT-140 line 3 subtractions 22,100.00; line 4 West Virginia AGI = 114,000.00 + 0.00 - 22,100.00 = 91,900.00. Line 5 Low-Income Earned Income Exclusion: federal AGI over 10,000, none. Line 6 exemptions 2 x 2,000.00 = 4,000.00. Line 7 taxable income = 91,900.00 - 4,000.00 = 87,900.00. Line 8 tax by Rate Schedule I (PDF p.37) bands: 2.22% x 10,000.00 = 222 + 2.96% x 15,000.00 = 444 + 3.33% x 15,000.00 = 499.5 + 4.44% x 20,000.00 = 888 + 4.82% x 27,900.00 = 1344.78; total 3398.28 = 3,398.28. The Tax Table row 87,900 to under 87,950 (PDF p.38 on) gives 3,399; expected keeps the schedule formula on the exact income. No Family Tax Credit (Modified Federal AGI above the table limits); credits 0.00; state income tax 3,398.28.
accepted_approximations: Tax below 100,000 of taxable income is figured on the exact income, where the booklet uses a Tax Table row's midpoint rounded to the whole dollar. Other tax is also rounded to the whole dollar in the booklet.
